first_attempt.observed_failure: Git rejected the rsync-preserved host-owned bind mount as dubious ownership when the container shell ran as root.

correction.before_execution: recursively assign the bind mount to container root so Git and build tools observe the same ownership relation as the local qualified runner
correction.before_transport_back: recursively restore the SSH host uid/gid so rsync can read all generated files
correction.clean_replay: apply the same ownership transitions around every remote replay

rerun_policy: Repeat the same previously-consumed case and retain both attempts.
